Description: Implement secure JWT session authentication, bcrypt password hashing, account lockout and RBAC authorization.
ACID protected stock level balance updates, reservation tracking, and item management.
Robot identity registration, secret management, battery monitoring, and heartbeat tracking.
Creation, assignment, and status transition of pickup and drop tasks.
Customer order placement, item reservation, fulfillment pipeline, and tracking.
HMAC-SHA256 command signing, UUID Nonce anti-replay verification, and state conflict prevention.
Tamper-evident audit log stream and real-time security metrics dashboard.
Hardened Docker image build, Kubernetes pod security, and automated CI/CD pipeline.
As a warehouse user, I want to securely log in, so that only authenticated users can access operations.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid credentials return JWT token. Invalid credentials rejected with 401.

Description: As a warehouse administrator, I want to assign roles to users safely.
Acceptance Criteria: Only Administrators can assign roles. Self-privilege escalation blocked with 403.

Description: As a warehouse operator, I want to view inventory.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized operators can view stock. Unauthorized users denied.

Description: As an admin, I want to update inventory stock with ACID transaction locks.
Acceptance Criteria: SQLAlchemy with_for_update locking. Negative stock rejected.

Description: As an admin, register robots with unique secrets and codes.
Acceptance Criteria: Robot identity verified via secret key. Duplicate IDs rejected.

Description: As an admin, authorize robot commands using HMAC-SHA256 signatures.
Acceptance Criteria: HMAC verification using robot secret key. Invalid signatures rejected.

Description: As an operator, monitor robot battery, location, and heartbeat.
Acceptance Criteria: Real-time heartbeat monitoring. Offline status alert after timeout.

Description: As an operator, create pickup and drop fulfillment tasks.
Acceptance Criteria: Task assigned unique task code and locations.

Description: As an admin, assign available IDLE robots to tasks.
Acceptance Criteria: Only IDLE robots assigned. Busy robots rejected.

Description: As system, prevent simultaneous execution of conflicting commands on same robot.
Acceptance Criteria: Active command state check. Concurrent calls rejected with 409 Conflict.

Description: As system, prevent replaying of past robot commands using nonces.
Acceptance Criteria: UUID Nonce tracking. Replayed nonces rejected with 400 Bad Request.

Description: As a customer, create and track warehouse order status.
Acceptance Criteria: Stock availability check before order creation.

Description: As an operator, completed robot tasks update order fulfillment status.
Acceptance Criteria: All tasks completion triggers FULFILLED status on customer order.

Description: As a security auditor, review security events and logs.
Acceptance Criteria: Log stream captures actor, role, action, result, IP, and timestamp.

Description: As security eng, automated Bandit, pip-audit, and pytest in CI/CD.
Acceptance Criteria: Pipeline blocks pull requests failing security scans.
